method: Actual published /1904/ app at 1280x800, `full`; animation paused after readiness; each stand renders the same held frame with the sun-pass test off (setCastersTowardView(false)), off again (the control) and on, reads triangles from renderer.info and every pixel with gl.readPixels in the same task. glessner-* stands are offsets in metres from Glessner's footprint centre. Software GL on this machine.
